name: matrix-application
description: A minimal browser shell built on Electron.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:context-menu && pnpm run build:chrome-web-store && pnpm run build:extensions && pnpm run build:shell
scripts.start: pnpm build:context-menu && pnpm build:extensions && pnpm build:chrome-web-store && pnpm --filter matrix-shell run start
scripts.start:electron-dev: cross-env ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH=$(e show out --path) ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 pnpm start
scripts.start:electron-dev:trace: cross-env ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH=$(e show out --path) ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 pnpm --filter matrix-shell run start:trace
scripts.start:skip-build: cross-env SHELL_DEBUG=true DEBUG='electron-chrome-extensions*' pnpm --filter matrix-shell run start
scripts.generate-noncompliant: cat noncompliant.txt | awk '{print tolower($0)}' | xargs -I {} node ./scripts/generate-hash.js {}

author: Samuel Maddock <sam@samuelmaddock.com>
